review_state: fitted C92 position photo-registered by assembly geometry and two owner views; marking and electrical rails unproved
source_context: The assembly draws horizontal C92 right of the vertical R4/R2/VD1 stack and above C31. Exact sheet-1 X8 supply detail draws C92 separately from ground to -12 V, despite the nearby collective C82...C93 text beside the +5 V/GND bypass symbol. The explicit C92 branch controls its rail assignment.
source_crossover_review: Native sheet-1 PXL_20260718_101827714.jpg crop (1150,450)-(2700,1500) shows C93's lower lead ending with a junction dot on the +12 V/B line. C92's lower lead passes that +12 V/B line without a junction dot and ends with a dot on the lower -12 V/C line; its upper lead joins ground. This visible crossover is the reason the two adjacent capacitors must not be assigned the same lower rail.
body_marking_recheck: Native July owner crops 200439607 (1150,2070)-(1520,2220) and 200450127 (1360,1650)-(1760,1820) both expose the same red molded body. The dark legend lies on its curved, glare-covered front face. Autocontrast and enlargement recover strokes but no complete numeric or unit code; neither view supports a value transcription. A lower-angle physical view or isolated capacitance measurement is needed.

owner_body.observation: A red molded horizontal axial body occupies the matching strip between the reset stack and C31 in two overlapping owner photographs. It carries dark printed characters, not discernible color bands, but the characters cannot be read reliably from either photograph. A separate lower glass axial body is in a different row and is not this candidate.

visible_copper_limit: The red body's left joint runs into a front trace that bends left under the neighboring upper can area; its right joint joins a vertical front trace. A separate open annulus near (1230,2090) caps the wide strip from D105's bottom-right contact, which is pin 14 with the visible notch-right orientation and +5 V in the source board netlist. The red left joint near (1225,2145) is about 55 px below that annulus with a visible front-side copper gap; do not merge the two by proximity. The adjacent can's visible terminal lead runs below the C92-left horizontal trace with brown clearance; any hidden under-body contact is unproved. The component side proves neither red-body joint to the source C92 rails GND and -12 V.

right_joint_front_strip_review.observation: The C92 right solder joint near (1465,2145) lies directly on a continuous narrow F.Cu vertical strip ending at an open annulus below the red body. At native crop (1430,1860)-(1570,2020), the green dipped body's near/lower lead is coated green as it bends across that strip, then continues as a dark wire to a separate round solder joint toward the IC. No solder bridge to the strip is visible at the crossing. The earlier claim that the strip reaches the green lead is retracted; their continuity remains unproved.
right_joint_front_strip_review.next_test: With power off, probe C92's right lead to the lower open annulus, then test the green body's actual near/lower round joint to that C92 strip separately. Test C92's strip against X8 -12 V and ground without inferring a green-body join from the insulated crossing.

may_red_green_crosscheck.observation: The independent oblique May view shows the same red C92-position body and green dipped body beside the marked IC. In native crop (2810,1760)-(3260,2550), the green near/lower lead arches above the narrow strip from the red joint and lands at a separate round solder pool toward the IC; the strip continues behind the coated lead without a visible junction. The green opposite lead lands at another distinct joint. This corroborates the July separation, not the former shared-node claim; neither green lead reaches a marked -12 V or ground terminal within this crop.
may_red_green_crosscheck.body_marking_limit: A native May enlargement exposes dark strokes on the red curved body, but they do not form a reliable capacitance or resistor code and cannot by themselves distinguish C92 from a nearby resistor if the assembly-to-photo placement is wrong. Keep the C92 physical identity assembly-supported and value open until endpoint measurement or a clearer marking view.

green_body_reference_exclusion: The green dipped body crossing above C92 right front strip is distinct from C93 in the power corner. Exact .009 assembly 114604420 explicitly draws C21 vertically below R20 and left of D52, matching this green body beside the owner D52 package in both July views. This supersedes the earlier tentative R19 reading based on proximity to C92. C21 body value and individual lead-net assignments remain unproved.

r19_source_discriminator_without_photo_j.source_observation: Exact .009 sheet 1 puts C92 lower plate and R19=470 ohm upper/input lead on the same -12 V conductor with filled junctions. R19 opposite lead reaches the -5 V derived node at VD5 before its grounded zener return. This source topology is closed; the assembly independently identifies the nearby green body as C21.
r19_source_discriminator_without_photo_j.photo_limit: May and July native crops show the C21-position green lower lead arched above the C92 strip and terminating at a separate round joint. The prior claimed red/green F.Cu join was a false crossing read. The factory C21 position supersedes the older green-as-R19 proximity guess, while its actual rail continuity is still unmeasured.
r19_source_discriminator_without_photo_j.discriminator: With power off, confirm C21 lower to R4 right and D13.5/RESIN, and C21 upper to R20 lower. Trace R20 opposite lead to its remote source return; do not assume +5 V or ground. Test C92 strip separately to -12 V; the coated C21 lead crossing is not a contact. Locate R19 at its separate assembly position and test it against -12 V and the VD5/D1.11/E5.1 -5 V network.

green_upper_to_r20_position_route.observation: The green body's upper/far lead is soldered at a large oval joint on an uninterrupted vertical F.Cu strip leading north to the lower lead joint of the vertical red axial body immediately east of registered D13. This is the opposite green lead from the coated lower lead that merely arches over C92's strip. The exact .009 assembly places vertical R20 to D13's right, matching the red body's location and posture; its owner body code is not fully legible in this crop.
green_upper_to_r20_position_route.may_cross_view_limit: The oblique May owner photo PXL_20260519_202052986.jpg, native crop (2500,1150)-(3500,2700), contains the same red resistor and green body. It shows the red resistor's lower joint continuing on a pale strip toward the green body, but perspective and the coated lead obscure the strip-to-green joint there. Use July for the visible joint and May only for component placement; neither view establishes the R20 reference or rail net without probing.
green_upper_to_r20_position_route.red_body_marking_recheck: Rotated native crops of the red axial body, July (1490,1360)-(1565,1630) and May (2850,1560)-(3220,1760), show dark hand-applied characters on different visible faces. The July view includes a shape like a 9 or 6 and a short upright stroke; the May view begins with a 1-like stroke. Glare, curvature and the different face angles prevent a unique 1K5 or 470 reading. Neither photo independently confirms the source R20=1.5 kilohm value, so retain R20 as a placement candidate rather than a value identification.
green_upper_to_r20_position_route.source_context: Exact .009 sheet 1 draws C21=24 in series with R20=1.5 kilohms below the R4/D13.5 RESIN junction. Assembly labels the adjacent green body C21 and red body R20 by position beside D52. July front copper joins C21 upper to R20 lower; D52-local two-face registration joins C21 lower to the R4-right solder trace. The remote R20 return destination remains untraced.
green_upper_to_r20_position_route.next_test: With power off, confirm C21 lower near front (1740,1530) to R4 right via solder (2380,1440) and to D13.5/RESIN; separately verify C21 upper/far joint to the R20-position lower lead, then trace the opposite R20 lead to its remote source return. Test C92 right strip independently against -12 V and the C21 coated crossing.

decision: The red molded axial body is the fitted component at the unique C92 assembly position, right of R4/R2/VD1 and above C31, corroborated by two overlapping owner views. Register its physical C92 position. Its unreadable marking and both rail joins remain open; if continuity contradicts the exact C92 ground/-12 V branch, investigate a board change or misregistration before assigning the replica pads. Do not classify C92 as DNP.
next_inspection: With power removed, meter C92-position red body leads near (1225,2145)/(1465,2145) to ground and -12 V at X8. Check its right strip to its lower open annulus and isolate it from the C21 coated crossing. Confirm C21 lower front (1740,1530) to R4 right solder (2380,1440) and D13.5/RESIN; confirm C21 upper to R20-position lower and trace R20 opposite lead to the remote return. Check C92 left lead against D105.14/+5 V at nearby annulus (1230,2090). Read C92, R20, and C21 markings under better light.
